_masks: [start_s, end_s, y_top, y_bottom]: hide Claude Code's grey prompt suggestions in the input line after the one human message
phases: The human sends one message: a goal and two examples.
Intake: herd init creates the task on a branch and stores the request verbatim. Risk: medium.
Criteria: C1 quotes the human. C2 and C3 add edge cases and a scale run. Each is a test.
Red first: herd verify runs the checks before any code. 3 of 3 fail, so they test something.
Build: writes slugify. herd verify: 3 of 3 pass.
Break it: 12 hostile titles and 1M characters. An em dash merged two words.
Fixes it, adds a regression test, logs each step with herd note.
Review: a fresh-context subagent reads only the goal, the criteria and the diff.
Review finds letters like þ and ð dropped, and apostrophes splitting words.
Fixes the findings, adds regression tests. herd verify: 3 of 3 pass.
herd done: evidence with the commit, red-first count, caveats and known limits.
Final report: what changed, each decision, and where "any title" fails.
